fixedFindings.problem: Owner-state UID maps updated existing keys by Remove followed by TryAdd. A failed replacement write could erase existing runtime truth or leave tombstone churn in lifecycle maps.
fixedFindings.fix: Added VaultUidMap.TryPut for in-place occupied-entry update and converted health, runtime flags, decomposition, damage progress, spore cadence, maturation, root-mound, and regrowth state writes to upserts.

fixedFindings.problem: Persisted flora override health/height and regrowth progress/position writes could succeed for one map and fail for the paired map, leaving half-state while callers published success.
fixedFindings.fix: Pair writes now snapshot previous values and rollback both maps on partial failure. Regrowth writes its progress/position pair before clearing destroyed/dead/decomposition truth and returns false with telemetry when storage fails.
